source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enable PXE on onboard NIC. Verify PXE boot function from each NIC port.
1. In BIOS setup, verify that all the PXE enabled NICs/LOMs show up in the boot sequence.
2. With all embedded and add-in NIC cards enabled, reboot the server and choose the PXE option.
3. Select the NIC port from the list for PXE boot.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. On board NIC ports should be shown in the boot sequence page when PXE function is enabled

original_test_intent: Verify that every approved onboard/LOM NIC exposes an IPv4 PXE boot entry in firmware and can be selected for the intended PXE boot path.
original_method: An operator enables PXE in BIOS, observes the boot-sequence entries, reboots and selects each NIC port; supporting automation correlates MAC/port identity with isolated DHCP/TFTP/boot-service logs and verifies restoration.
manual_activity: The acceptance-critical BIOS boot-sequence observation and selection of each IPv4 PXE NIC are operator actions; the agent may prepare the service and collect correlated logs only.
required_inputs: Expected embedded/add-in NIC list and physical-to-MAC mapping
Isolated IPv4 DHCP/PXE boot service and image
Console/BMC access, reboot approval and restore plan
safety_requirements: Scope DHCP/PXE responses to the test SUT to prevent unintended network boots.
Do not substitute Linux NIC visibility or server logs for firmware entry observation.
Record and restore original PXE and boot-order settings.
Stop on ambiguous port mapping, wrong boot target, isolation failure or access loss; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare/read PXE service readiness, collect OS NIC inventory and correlate DHCP/TFTP/boot logs to the operator-selected MAC/port.
Compare supporting evidence and restoration/health state without claiming the manual firmware criterion or verdict.
engineer_actions: Enable IPv4 PXE, inspect every firmware boot entry, select each approved NIC and record the result.
Restore firmware settings and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its narrative accurately states that OS commands cannot drive or prove the pre-OS menu; no executable command is supplied for the manual core.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use project-approved read-only NIC inventory and PXE-server log collection only as supporting evidence, keyed by MAC, port and timestamp.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The per-port IPv4 PXE scope and 40/40-minute values remain; no automatic firmware interaction is claimed.

modernized_recommendation.status: OPERATOR PXE BOOT WITH CORRELATED NETWORK EVIDENCE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record firmware entry and selected port on console while correlating that exact MAC/port to isolated DHCP and boot-transfer logs, then restore the original boot state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Servers with firmware IPv4 PXE support on approved NICs.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, NIC firmware, PXE service and boot-image versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform firmware boot/PXE documentation and the approved PXE service configuration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit NIC identity, network isolation, server-side correlation and restoration evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Demonstrates both firmware presentation and actual selected-port network exchange without treating OS enumeration as firmware proof.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: NIC map, isolated service and expected boot behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Pre-OS interaction remains manual; network logs alone cannot prove the correct firmware entry was shown or selected.

project_override_considerations: A project may select a subset of ports or approved boot image, but the report must name the tested ports and cannot claim untested NIC coverage.
expected_evidence: Approved NIC/LOM map and isolated PXE service readiness
Operator BIOS boot-sequence captures for every scoped NIC
Per-port selection evidence correlated to DHCP/TFTP/boot logs
Pre/post OS NIC and BMC health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure and criterion consistently require firmware IPv4 PXE entries and operator selection.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The test intent is clear and executable by an operator; manual core acceptance makes it MANUAL ONLY, not blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps its correct manual boundary and adds safe, auditable supporting evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains per-port correlation, isolation and restore controls.

review_improvement: Prevents a generic NIC listing or PXE-server response from being mistaken for proof that every required firmware boot entry was present and selected.
independent_technical_reasoning: The criterion is explicitly a pre-OS visual/interactive firmware property; server-side automation can corroborate a chosen port's network boot but cannot replace that observation.
